DATA_PATH = 'data/dataset.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(DATA_PATH)

# Display the first few rows of the dataset
df.head()

# Check for missing values in the trans_amount column
missing_values = df['trans_amount'].isnull().sum()
missing_values

# Calculate the total transaction amount
total_amount = df['trans_amount'].sum()

# Calculate daily returns (percentage change)
df['daily_return'] = df['trans_amount'].pct_change()

# Display the first few rows with daily returns
df[['trans_amount', 'daily_return']].head()

import numpy as np

# Remove NaN values from daily_return
cleaned_returns = df['daily_return'].dropna()

# Simulate 10,000 scenarios of portfolio returns
num_simulations = 10000
simulated_returns = np.random.choice(cleaned_returns, (num_simulations, len(cleaned_returns)), replace=True)

# Calculate the mean and standard deviation of the simulated returns
mean_returns = simulated_returns.mean(axis=1)
std_returns = simulated_returns.std(axis=1)

# Display the mean and standard deviation of the simulated returns
mean_returns.mean(), std_returns.mean()

# Calculate the 95% VaR
VaR_95 = np.percentile(mean_returns, 5)
VaR_95

# Calculate the mean and standard deviation of the cleaned daily returns
mean_daily_return = cleaned_returns.mean()
std_daily_return = cleaned_returns.std()

# Calculate Z-scores
z_scores = (cleaned_returns - mean_daily_return) / std_daily_return

# Identify outliers (Z-score > 3 or < -3)
outliers = cleaned_returns[(z_scores > 3) | (z_scores < -3)]

# Display the outliers
outliers
